scope: Coverage counts from completely decoded real functions, not timings and not the separately filtered common-iced SIMD panel.
root_boundary: The original 32-bit C4/C5 simple-output table cells are zero, so they miss before the existing vector writer. The zero-plan-miss prototype reaches 2605 more real JPEG32 instructions and improves format/detail about 40%, but Clang14 expands ordinary iterator text by 16 bytes and moves 4035 native/983 mixed text symbols. Its nine losses remain disqualifying.
residual_register_cause: vex_register_row requires three NDS operands except immediate shifts. Two-register VMOVDQA therefore has no generated row despite writeVectorRegisters already accepting a register count.
residual_memory_cause: The VEX32 helper deliberately admits only register ModR/M. The existing indexed vector memory writer accepts only VMOVAPS and one FMA shape with a base/index/disp8, and writes 64-bit address records. The real residuals are mostly VMOVDQU, VPMADDWD, VMOVDQA and VPADD*. Enabling that old writer alone will not cover those forms.
next_boundary: After qualifying entry dispatch, generate uniform two-register rows from the canonical decoder and share the existing complete-record writer at the same token position. For memory, extend a canonical address/operand owner; retain explicit 32-bit address fields, displacement, SIB, access, groups, error and cursor semantics.

iced_source.observation: FastFormatter starts from normalized instruction Code and operand kinds, loads code-indexed mnemonic data and emits register/memory fields directly. This supports using existing canonical admission data and shared writers; it does not justify caching mutable Capstone options or discarding public detail fields.
